# rustinion_notification_channel (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion notification channel (Slack, generic webhook, email, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or Twilio SMS/voice call). See notifications.rs in the main repo for exactly how each channel_type is dispatched.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_type` (String) One of: email, slack, webhook, pagerduty, opsgenie, sms, voice.
- `config` (String, Sensitive) The channel's config as a JSON string, shape depending on channel_type: slack: {"webhook_url": "..."}; webhook: {"url": "...", "secret": "..."} (secret optional); email: {"recipients": ["..."]}; pagerduty: {"routing_key": "..."}; opsgenie: {"api_key": "...", "region": "us"|"eu"} (region optional, defaults to us); sms/voice: {"account_sid": "...", "auth_token": "...", "from_number": "+1...", "to_numbers": ["+1..."]} (a real Twilio account — sms sends a text via Twilio's Messages API, voice places a call and reads the alert aloud via Twilio's Calls API). Marked sensitive since every shape but email holds a secret.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `body_template` (String) Custom alert body, same `{{variable}}` substitution as `subject_template`. Omit for the built-in format.
- `digest_interval_minutes` (Number)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `grouping_dimension` (String)
- `grouping_enabled` (Boolean) Opt in to alert grouping/deduplication for this channel. Defaults to false.
- `grouping_window_minutes` (Number)
- `payload_template` (String) Webhook channels only: the entire JSON request body, replacing the default `{"subject","body","severity"}` envelope. Substituted values are JSON-escaped automatically, so a detail containing quotes stays valid. Rejected at apply time if it doesn't parse as JSON once variables are filled in.
- `severities` (Set of String) Finding severities this channel gets: any of `critical`, `warning`, `info`. Omit for the channel type's default: pagerduty, opsgenie, sms and voice page a person, so they get `critical` only; email, slack and webhook get every severity. An empty set sends nothing.
- `subject_template` (String) Custom alert subject, with `{{variable}}` substitution. Omit for the built-in format. Available variables: `reason`, `hostname`, `group`, `detail`, `severity`, `device_id`, `group_id`, `package`. An unknown variable renders as empty.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
